test.name: Test Map
test.blurb: DEV MAP (goes away when the game is published). A flat floor with still dummies. Every weapon you have switched on is laid out in a row. No crates.

practice.name: Practice Range
practice.blurb: DEV MAP (goes away when the game is published). Still and moving dummies at 10 to 60 metres, and a rack of the best ranged weapons. No crates.

arena.name: Sunny Arena
arena.blurb: Open edges and crates. Knock people off!

park.name: Bouncy Rooftop
park.blurb: Bounce pads and a high platform. No safe edge.

temple.name: Temple Ruins
temple.blurb: A giant stepped pyramid, towers and stepping stones. Climb it all!

rooftops.name: Rooftops
rooftops.blurb: Nine rooftops, bridges between them and the street far below. Highest roof wins.

shrink.name: Shrink Zone
shrink.blurb: The floor keeps getting smaller, then grows back out before it gets too cramped. Stay on it. If everyone falls it comes back at half size.

squeeze.name: Squeeze Chamber
squeeze.blurb: A long chamber whose two ends keep closing in, faster than the Shrink Zone, then opening back out. The sides stay put, so the fight gets squeezed into a tight lane. Crates in the middle for cover.

tower.name: Tiered Tower
tower.blurb: A wide stepped tower with a fighting floor on every level. Stairs on the sides, a ladder to the summit and bounce pads at the corners. King of the hill, no climbing puzzle.

arenaxl.name: Grand Arena
arenaxl.blurb: A huge open arena: a tower in the middle, four corner platforms and crates everywhere. Open edges, so mind the drop.

rinkxl.name: Grand Rink
rinkxl.blurb: A giant ice rink. Everything slides, so use the pillars and walls to stop.

colosseum.name: Colosseum
colosseum.blurb: A sandy fighting pit ringed by tall pillars, with a raised stage in the middle and low gates to hide behind.

fortress.name: Fortress Yard
fortress.blurb: A walled courtyard with four gates, corner towers with ladders and a keep in the middle. Lots of cover.

moonbase.name: Moon Base
moonbase.blurb: A quiet grey moon with the Earth hanging in the sky. Fight around the dome pods, the crater rings and the central launch pad.

volcano.name: Volcano Rim
volcano.blurb: Four rock islands round a burning crater, joined by narrow bridges. Fall in the lava and you are out. Knock people in!

candy.name: Candy Land
candy.blurb: Lollipop trees, candy-cane pillars and a giant cake in the middle. Sticky, sweet and a bit silly.

pirate.name: Pirate Ship
pirate.blurb: Board the big ship! Mast in the middle, a raised stern deck, rowing boats alongside and planks between. Do not fall in the sea.

haunted.name: Haunted Hollow
haunted.blurb: A foggy graveyard under a full moon. Hide behind tombstones, climb the crypt and watch the green wisps float by.

beach.name: Sunset Beach
beach.blurb: A sandy island at sunset with palm trees, beach huts and a sandcastle. Waves all around, so keep your feet on the sand.

dojo.name: Moonlit Dojo
dojo.blurb: Built for ninjas. A raised dojo with a pagoda roof, stairs on every side, low garden walls and corner pavilions to dash between and hide behind. Lanterns and cherry blossom in the moonlight.

blast.name: Blast Yard
blast.blurb: Built for explosives. A concrete test range with a central bunker, four corner towers to rain rockets from, barrel stacks, bounce pads and walls to hide behind. Open edges, so one big blast can send you flying.

gunrange.name: Firing Range
gunrange.blurb: Built for guns. Long sight-lines down painted shooting lanes, sandbag walls to duck behind, a sniper tower in the middle and four corner nests with a view of everything. Open edges, so mind the drop.

brawlpit.name: Brawl Pit
brawlpit.blurb: Built for close combat. A boxing ring in the middle with ropes on two sides and stairs on the others, tyre stacks to dodge round, bleachers in the corners to leap off and bounce pads to get back in. Open edges, so one big whack can send you flying.

craterdome.name: Crater Dome
craterdome.blurb: Built for Moon Drift. A lunar crater under a glass dome with Earth hanging in the sky. Leap off the moon rocks and float up to the drifting asteroid platforms, and bounce off the glass.

capsule.name: Space Capsule
capsule.blurb: Built for Moon Drift. The inside of a space capsule: big glass windows onto space, a glowing core in the middle and platforms to drift between. Use the walls to bounce off.

pillars.name: Pillars
pillars.blurb: Eight tall pillars in a ring over the sea, with nothing in the middle. The gaps are too wide to jump, so you need a dash (any weapon can dash here). Every 10 seconds a new weapon lands in your inventory. Fall or die and you are out for the match. Most K.O.s when the clock ends wins.

playroom.name: Giant's Playroom
playroom.blurb: A kid's room as seen by a giant. A teddy bear in the corner, a tennis ball, dice, a toy car, building bricks, a book stack to climb, crayons for cover and bounce pads between.

farm.name: Sunny Farm
farm.blurb: A big farm on a sunny morning. Run into the big red barn and up to its hayloft, hide behind hay bales, fight round the tractor and the coop, or race over the haystack in the middle.

crossroads.name: Neon Crossroads
crossroads.blurb: A plus-shaped street high above the city. Four arms, a raised hub and nothing but sky in the corners, so every shove can be the last. Bounce pads fling you back toward the middle.

donut.name: Donut Drop
donut.blurb: A giant frosted donut with a hole in the middle. Run the ring, or take a bounce pad over the hole to the sprinkle island. Fall through the hole and you are out.

chasm.name: Chasm Bridge
chasm.blurb: Two cliffs, two narrow bridges and a small island in the chasm between them. A long, thin level that fits a phone screen. Hold the bridges, or bounce across.

summit.name: Summit Rush
summit.blurb: A long ridge in seven steps, low at both ends and high in the middle. Fight uphill, shove people downhill, hold the peak. Bounce pads at the foot hop you up the first step.
